A1.justification: Both PDFs describe FreeKV and provide readable text, equations, tables and figures supporting a reliable comparison. Both contain 12 pages, ending with references; neither contains an appendix.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark accuracy, inference latency and optimization ablations in Tables 2–3 and Figures 7–8.

after.justification: v3 retains the original accuracy, latency and ablation results in Tables 2–3 and Figures 7–8.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 retain identical speculative retrieval, group-consistent selection, fine-grained correction, hybrid memory layouts and double-buffered streamed recall procedures.

E1.justification: Both retain the same scenarios in Figure 1 and the same LongBench v2, LongGenBench, MATH500, AIME24 and GPQA evaluations in Section 5. No dataset, task or domain coverage changes.

E2.justification: Tables 2–3 retain full-KV references and RazorAttention, RaaS, Quest, ArkVale and ShadowKV. Figure 7 retains ArkVale, ShadowKV, RaaS and RazorAttention as efficiency comparators. Their documented adaptations are unchanged.

E3.justification: Sections 5.1–5.3 preserve the model configurations, problem subsets, metrics, decoding settings, context lengths and batch sizes. The KV budget of 2048 and page size of 32 are unchanged.

E4.justification: Figure 3 retains the query-similarity and attention-pattern analyses. Figure 8 retains the same ablation of hybrid layouts, double buffering and speculative retrieval, with no additional robustness or sensitivity analysis.

E5.justification: Both report k = 8 generated samples per reasoning problem and the same pass@k and avg@k measures in Section 5.2. Run, seed and uncertainty reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and findings in Tables 2–3 and Figures 1, 3, 7–8 are unchanged. For example, both report FreeKV's 29.22 LongBench v2 overall score with Llama-3.1-8B and maximum speedups of 13.7× over ArkVale and 8.4× over ShadowKV.

T1.justification: The attention formulation, group-consistency definition, cosine-similarity expression and pooled selection equations in Sections 2–3 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same algorithm-system contributions and claims of near-lossless accuracy and up to 13× speedup over existing KV retrieval methods.

C2.justification: Both retain the query-similarity explanation, interpretation of ShadowKV reconstruction errors, and Section 6 discussion of adaptive budgets and page-wise selection limitations at small budgets.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information is unchanged, including memory layouts, buffering, hyperparameters and the A100 40GB GPU with AMD 7302 CPUs over PCIe Gen4. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: The same 49 references and their substantive uses are retained. Positioning against KV dropping, retrieval and related sparse-attention approaches is unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 adds Jing Lin, Yiwu Yao and Danning Ke to the author list, adds the Huawei affiliation and updates the version/date header. Scientific prose, terminology and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded author block occupies two lines and introduces numbered affiliations, slightly shifting the first-page text. Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–3 retain their designs, captions and placement.

improvement.justification: v3 changes authorship and affiliation information with minor first-page layout adjustments. The methods, evidence, explanations, limitations and reproducibility information remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful difference in the paper's scientific or expository quality.
